what: Step 7a helper absorbs 7a.r while leaving macro routing outside
scenario_or_breakage: Current macro routing branches on the rebase probe process exit plus REBASE_OUTCOME stdout. Inside a quiet helper the probe output can be logged instead of surfaced, and the plan says step-7a exits 0 then runs flush, so a conflict or non-conflict rebase failure can fall through toward Step 8 instead of entering the conflict or stall path.
suggested_fix: Keep rebase-checkpoint-probe as its own foreground SKILL.md fence between diagram composition and flush, or split the helper into pre-rebase and post-rebase helpers. If the helper must own 7a.r, it also must own the macro routing/resume semantics and add conflict and non-conflict failure tests.

what: Plan removes the 7a.r direct probe from SKILL.md but does not update the structural guard
scenario_or_breakage: The guard currently requires exactly four rebase-checkpoint-probe.sh invocations in SKILL.md, including the 7a.r literal and nearby forked_target guard. After the proposed SKILL.md collapse, make lint fails even if runtime behavior is otherwise correct.
suggested_fix: Update this harness and its docs to accept three direct SKILL.md probes plus the new step-7a.sh probe contract, or keep the 7a.r probe in SKILL.md.

what: New helper bootstrap cannot satisfy its own env rehydration contract when plugin root is absent
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says step-7a.sh recovers missing CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT from IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh, but bootstrap first sources "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib-quiet.sh" without defining PLUGIN_ROOT. A direct harness or resumed invocation with only --implement-tmpdir can fail before read-session-env-key.sh runs.
suggested_fix: Initialize SCRIPT_DIR and PLUGIN_ROOT from the new script path before sourcing lib-quiet, then optionally recover/export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT from session-env. Add an env-missing harness case.
